resources.string: The widget follows future changes to the calendars shown in the app.
These choices are independent of the app’s calendar filters, other widgets, and reminders.
The app currently selects no calendars.
This saved choice is kept. Remove it only if you no longer want it included.
Its availability could not be checked. The saved choice is kept.
Access must be confirmed before adding this calendar. An existing selection can be removed.
Availability only: the widget shows Busy and dates/times, even when event titles are enabled.
No calendars selected. This widget will show no events.
Only Busy and event dates/times are shown. Event titles, locations, descriptions, and calendar colors stay hidden.
Event titles and calendar colors are visible on your home screen. Anyone who can see the widget can read them.
Calendar access is needed to check the available calendars.
Calendars are unavailable. Your widget choices are kept.
